name: risk_manager
description: AI-powered fraud detection platform that identifies suspicious transactions, abusive returns, and chargeback risks using machine learning, explainable predictions, and interactive dashboards. Built with React, FastAPI, Python, and Scikit-learn.

paragraphs: Defense-only loss detection for fraud, abusive returns and chargebacks. It scores every transaction, explains why, recommends an action (allow / monitor / review / hold), and picks its operating point from what mistakes cost, not from accuracy. Built to the product spec's MVP: Fraud-Spike Detector + Risk Verifier.

Data honesty. All data is synthetic (backend/app/data/generatedataset.py) because public fraud datasets lack device/account/network fields. Every metric below describes simulated ground truth, not production performance.

whatItDoes.text: Defense-only loss detection for fraud, abusive returns and chargebacks. It scores every transaction, explains why, recommends an action (allow / monitor / review / hold), and picks its operating point from what mistakes cost, not from accuracy. Built to the product spec's MVP: Fraud-Spike Detector + Risk Verifier.

requirements.text: Sign up as a normal user, or use Administrator sign-in (link at the bottom of the sign-in page).

Backend: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy (SQLite by default, PostgreSQL via DATABASEURL); multi-step authentication with role-based access (viewer / analyst / admin); rate limiting; audit log of every score, review, sign-in and config change; analyst review workflow; batch CSV scoring; scenario simulator; CSV export; SSRF-guarded alert webhook.

Public site and dashboard (React + TypeScript): Landing page with a draggable 3D hero · Sign up · Sign in (two-step) · Administrator sign-in · Forgot/reset password · Privacy and Terms · custom 404 · signed-in welcome page · Overview · Alert queue with filters/pagination/export · Alert detail drawer (reasons, SHAP bars, customer timeline, related accounts,…

Admin accounts cannot sign in through the public form (and vice versa), cannot be created via sign-up or the API (only make admin / python -m app.auth.createadmin), get shorter sessions (10-min access token, 8-hour maximum), and can be limited to trusted networks with ADMINALLOWEDIPS.
For stricter privacy, self-host them and drop the two Google hosts from the CSP in frontend/nginx.conf.
